headline: Breaking: Prabowo Calls MSCI Boss to Discuss RI Stock Exchange
summary: President Prabowo Subianto met MSCI CEO Henry Fernandez to discuss alternatives to prevent a downgrade of Indonesia's stock market status. The meeting was reported by CNBC Indonesia.
why: MSCI index classification determines passive fund flows into a market, so a status downgrade can trigger large foreign outflows from its stocks.
why_moved: Talks about preventing a downgrade of Indonesia's market status by MSCI, a key index provider, bear on the risk of foreign fund outflows.
original_headline: Breaking: Prabowo Telepon Bos MSCI Bicara soal Bursa RI
